---
title: "usethis asks a question that a script cannot hear"
ref: PKG-10
categories: [Packages]
impact: cryptique
attendu: "a new package created in the subfolder"
versions: "All versions of {usethis}, the wording of the message has changed"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2020, 2024)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```bash
Rscript -e 'usethis::create_package("tools/mypackage", open = FALSE)'
```

```text
! New project 'tools/mypackage' would be nested inside an existing project
  '...', which is rarely a good idea.
[...]
Error in `ui_yep()`:
✖ User input required, but session is not interactive.
ℹ Query: "Do you want to create anyway?"
```
:::

This pitfall depends on a non-interactive R session and on writing a project to disk, so it cannot be replayed in the browser. The output is the one from {usethis} 3.2.1.

## Why

When the new project sits inside another one (a folder that already contains a `.Rproj`, a `DESCRIPTION` or a `.git`), {usethis} asks for confirmation. In an interactive session, you answer yes. In an `Rscript`, a CI job or a call from another function, nobody can answer: depending on the version, the call used to hang on the question, or now stops with this error.

## The remedy

Explicitly allow the nested project through the option designed for it, or create the package outside the parent project.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
withr::with_options(
  list(usethis.allow_nested_project = TRUE),
  code = usethis::create_package("tools/mypackage", open = FALSE)
)
```
:::
